title: Role Assistant: Inline Recommendations & Safe Change Preview
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Introduce a lightweight 'Role Assistant' within the Console role editor and member assignment flows that provides inline recommendations, a simulated audit-log preview, and a safe-change diff before committing role edits. Goal: reduce developer friction when creating/updating roles, lower misconfiguration risk, and surface downstream audit effects for compliance reviewers. The assistant should combine template suggestions, permission impact estimates, and a one-click rollback/undo path. Non-goal: building an automated policy engine or replacing enterprise approval workflows.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: When editing role permissions, the Role Assistant surfaces 2-3 template recommendations (e.g., read-only, deployer-lite, billing-ops) with an estimated confidence score and reason for each suggestion.

AC2: The UI shows a simulated audit-log preview summarizing: who will be recorded as the actor, which permissions changed, and a human-readable change summary. This preview must match the format of real audit entries for downstream reviewers.

AC3: A permission-delta diff is shown inline: added permissions, removed permissions, and permission scope changes. Each diff line includes a one-click 'explain' affordance linking to docs about that permission's impact.
AC4: Bulk assignment flow suggests group matches from SSO/SAML mappings (when SSO enabled) and warns on orphaned members. Acceptance requires a confirm/preview step before applying.

AC5: The change preview provides an estimate of affected resources and a risk band (low/medium/high) based on historical telemetry; estimate must be visible and have a tooltip describing data sources.
AC6: All changes create an auditable record (draft) that will be written to the audit log on commit; test shows an audit entry created with expected fields in staging environment.

AC7: Safety controls: ability to limit rollout to a subset of tenants/org-units (canary), and a visible undo option for 24 hours post-change must be implemented or stubbed with a clear fallback message.
AC8: Designs meet accessibility baseline (WCAG AA) and keyboard flows are documented for role assistant interactions.
AC9: PM and Eng sign-off on API surface for preview data (permission impact API) and on required telemetry hooks for confidence scoring.
AC10: Performance: assistant UI must render within 250ms for cached templates and within 800ms for fresh impact estimates on typical org sizes (<= 10k members).
